budget: Suno 300クレジット以内・購入なし（本人10/26）
trial: まず各種1回（12曲・60見込み）で声・楽器・尺を確かめてから残り18回

leads.name: ペダルスチール・ギター
leads.style: Dreamy pedal steel guitar in the foreground, long smooth gliding slides and gently swelling sustained notes, a simple singing melody, clean and warm, not country, no twang. D major, 88 BPM. Instrumental night-drive chill for a calm late-autumn drive along a bayside expressway at night. A relaxed steady groove with soft mixed live and electronic drums, a round warm bass and warm analog-style pads underneath. Smooth, warm and unhurried, gentle tape warmth. A long, continuous piece that keeps the same easy groove all the way through, with no breakdowns and no dramatic build. It continues in this same way for many minutes. About four minutes, gentle natural ending. No vocals, no humming, no whistling. No car or engine sounds, no city ambience, no rain. No dog sounds, no barking.
